name: Acceptance test 24 - graph semantic typing (no generic can-write aggregation)
note: IAM-702 edge typing: one statement mixes a read (ec2:DescribeInstances), a decrypt (kms:Decrypt), a delegation (iam:PassRole), and a destroy (s3:DeleteObject) on Resource:*. Each maps to its OWN capability edge - can-read, can-decrypt, can-pass (delegation), can-destroy - never one aggregate can-write. Each edge retains only the action relevant to it (cross-test invariant 7, 'no semantic edge reuse'). iam:PassRole alone draws a delegation edge only: with no compatible service-execution primitive it must NOT create an execution path (no can-execute-as).
